about_the_game:
Reiner Knizia's Samurai is a classic strategic board game that immerses players in feudal Japan, competing to gain influence over three vital elements of society: food, religion, and military. Players use hexagonal tiles to strategically claim control of cities and villages across the map, balancing their moves carefully to achieve dominance in one or more elements while maintaining an edge over their opponents.

In this digital adaptation, you can enjoy all the strategic depth of the original game. Play against a challenging computer AI or test your skills against other players in real-time multiplayer matches or at your own pace with asynchronous gameplay. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or new to the game, this digital version offers a seamless and engaging experience with stunning visuals and intuitive controls.

Features:

* Playing against AI characters with various tactics in three different levels of difficulty and personalities

* Multiplayer mode to compete with up to three other players in both private and public games

* Play both turn based async or turn based in real time

If you like the board game Samurai, you will love this game!
